evidence_scope: locally locked confirmation on uninspected outcome rows of a published benchmark, new plot-area/geographic domain; not a new independent data release or secret test
training: original E1 probcal and riskcal roles only; no E2 hyperparameter choices; refit exact original shared Platt and HGB parameters
primary_candidate: unchanged SDC selection plus training-only positive-slope affine F1 magnitude calibration
primary_comparator: fixed original E1 HGB loss regression on original 12 risk features
magnitude_clipping: clip both affine-SDC and HGB quality predictions to [0,1] for MSE; report unclipped sensitivity. Acceptance uses original ordinal scores, with SDC itself resolving affine saturation/ties
quotas: country by original probcal-defined area bins; exact largest remainder at 80 percent, same budgets for every method
co_primary_endpoints: all-cell mean error MSE: HGB minus calibrated SDC
retained-cell sample F1: SDC minus HGB
secondary_analyses: Brazil subgroup and non-Brazil sensitivity without replacing primary
rare occurrence service, precision and recall using original PO rarity
new-domain covariate-only area-quintile quota sensitivity because original area bins may saturate
target_access_order: lock config/cohort/code; fit all four calibration/selection heads and freeze assessment scores/acceptance masks; then record first target access and materialize only approved unconsumed E3 rows
GPU_stage_if_primary_and_correctness_pas: one private Kaggle CUDA replay of frozen scalar magnitude heads/operating decisions, maximum 20 minutes; validate numerical stability on same fixed inputs. No new backbone training or fresh confirmation claimed
source_and_PO_backbone_overlap: some source IDs overlap earlier reliability data; original SAGE PO backbone training can include evaluation cells; only E3 outcome/geographic/plot-area holdout is asserted
